evidence: Single migration 0109_support_health_id_matches.sql, unsigned until the owner signs (reviewed_by is empty). WHAT IT DOES: creates identity.support_health_id_matches(candidates text[]) RETURNS TABLE(health_id text), language plpgsql, STABLE, SECURITY DEFINER, search_path pg_catalog, pg_temp, owned by identity.patients' owner, EXECUTE for hid_identity_runtime only (none for PUBLIC), in the file and in runtime-grants.sql; nothing else. It answers the candidates that are an issued Health ID (identity.patients.hid_code, any status), each once, in order, and nothing else about any patient; 1 to 200 candidates, each HID- and 6 to 32 Health ID characters upper case (the hid_code CHECK of 0002), anything else raises 22023, so a bad request never answers no match. The match is upper(hid_code) = any(candidates), on 0002's unique index patients_hid_code_ci_uq. No table, column, constraint, index, policy, trigger, role or other function changes; no row read or written. BACKWARD COMPATIBLE: nothing calls the function until identity-api's support route is released, and today's identity-api never names it. PRECONDITIONS (catalog reads only; 55000 or 42501, nothing applied): 0001-0108 applied (0108's cover body md5 6928763d3b69f0e4b4acf96a6a255736 is the marker); not applied yet (else '0109: already applied'); identity.patients.hid_code text NOT NULL, its unique index on upper(hid_code), and no forced row-level security on identity.patients (else the owner would see no Health ID and every check would answer no match); the applier may SET ROLE to identity.patients' owner, which has CREATE on schema identity. POST-CHECKS: owner, language, SECURITY DEFINER, STABLE, set-returning, search_path, the result TABLE(health_id text), and the ACL exactly the owner and hid_identity_runtime EXECUTE. PROVED on local PostgreSQL 16.15 clusters (created and deleted): FRESH install of all 110 files 0001-0109 and every database suite (scripts/run-container-database-acceptance.sh through its migrations/schema, representative logins/denials and PostgreSQL TLS stages); UPGRADE with services/ehr-api/scripts/test-staging-schema-upgrade.mjs (HID_REHEARSAL_ADMIN_URL, a NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS migrator, baseline 0001-0108 with the base's runtime-grants.sql, declared exactly 0109). SUITE: services/ehr-api/test/database/support-health-id-matches.integration.sql, 22 cases: issued only, each once, every status (active, inactive, merged, deceased, deleted), 32 characters, letters only, no match is an empty answer, 200 candidates; refusals 22023 for none, null, 201, lower case, 5 and 33 characters, a letter outside the alphabet, no prefix, a null among them, a nested array, a valid one beside a malformed one; 42501 for the EHR runtime, the Lab runtime and the OCR worker; and hid_identity_runtime with no context reads none of the fixture patients through identity.patients itself. MUTANTS: no input check (caught: 2b and the other refusals), active patients only (caught: 1a, 1c), EXECUTE to PUBLIC (caught by the suite's grant check); dropping distinct is equivalent (the unique index on upper(hid_code) already makes each match one row).
